newsitem.title: USA: Pratt says wins $210mln Thai Int'l order.
newsitem.headline: Pratt says wins $210mln Thai Int'l order.

text.p: Jet engine maker Pratt & Whitney, a unit of United Technologies Corp, said Tuesday that Thai International airways had increased its engine order in a deal worth about $210 million to Pratt.
The 19 additional engines, including spares, will power Thai's new Airbus Industrie wide bodies, Pratt said in a statement.
All aircraft will be delivered in 1998 and 1999.
Thai will acquire five more Airbus A300 aircraft powered by Pratt's PW4158 and four more A330s that use the larger, more powerful PW4168 engine, Pratt said.
The airline currently operates both A300 and A330 aircraft with Pratt engines.
Pratt said that during the 1990s, PW4000 engines have been selected in about 40 percent of all engine competitions among the three major suppliers.
